lwc.description: Lightning Web Components - Frontend UI components
lwc.readme: Create LWC components here. Each component gets its own folder with .js, .html, .css, and .js-meta.xml files.

classes.readme: Create Apex classes here: Services, Controllers, Selectors, Handlers, Utils, Tests.

triggers.readme: Create triggers here. One trigger per object. Use handler pattern for logic.

objects.readme: Define custom objects here. Each object gets a folder with object-meta.xml and fields subfolder.

tabs.readme: Create custom tabs for your objects and apps.

flexipages.readme: Create Lightning pages: Home pages, Record pages, App pages.

applications.readme: Create Lightning apps with navigation and branding.

permissionsets.readme: Define permission sets for user access control.

layouts.readme: Create page layouts for object record pages.

flows.readme: Create flows for automation and business processes.

staticresources.readme: Upload static files: images, CSS, JavaScript libraries, etc.

scripts-readme.content:
# Scripts

## setup.apex
Apex script to create demo data

```bash
sf apex run --file scripts/setup.apex
```

## deploy.sh
Deployment automation script

```bash
chmod +x scripts/deploy.sh
./scripts/deploy.sh
```

project-readme.content:
# {{PROJECT_NAME}}

{{PROJECT_DESCRIPTION}}

## Tech Stack

- **Platform**: Salesforce
- **Frontend**: Lightning Web Components (LWC)
- **Backend**: Apex
- **Database**: Salesforce Objects
- **Deployment**: Salesforce CLI (sf)

## Setup

### Prerequisites
- Salesforce CLI: `npm install -g @salesforce/cli`
- Developer Org: https://developer.salesforce.com/signup

### Login to Org
```bash
sf org login web --alias DevOrg
sf config set target-org DevOrg
```

### Deploy
```bash
sf project deploy start
```

### Open Org
```bash
sf org open
```

## Development

### Deploy Changes
```bash
sf project deploy start
```

### Retrieve Changes
```bash
sf project retrieve start
```

### Run Tests
```bash
sf apex run test --test-level RunLocalTests
```

## Project Structure

```
/
├── force-app/main/default/
│   ├── lwc/              # Lightning Web Components
│   ├── classes/          # Apex classes
│   ├── triggers/         # Apex triggers
│   ├── objects/          # Custom objects
│   └── ...
├── scripts/              # Deployment and setup scripts
├── config/               # Org configurations
└── sfdx-project.json     # SFDX configuration
```
